notes.en:
## New Features

- Add ToolSearch to discover and load optional tool groups and MCP tools by capability, with disabled, automatic and resident MCP loading modes.
- Add /modeltrace for a single-turn model fingerprint test that reuses the source conversation prefix and cache identity, with a compact top-five candidate probability view and navigation back to the source session.
- Add protocol-aware, batched historical token recalculation from an on-demand usage-history dialog; the background task continues after the dialog closes.
- Extend generated UI previews with Bun builds, preview screenshots and runtime inspection feedback.

## Improvements

- Make Send fully asynchronous: replies arrive as ordinary messages and wake the sender when idle. Surface blocked deliveries, add resume/discard controls, and let parents switch subagent models.
- Move code syntax tokenization into a Worker, batch highlight notifications and reduce per-row rendering overhead for smoother long-conversation scrolling.
- Improve page and dialog loading feedback, load translations by interface layer and preload common entry points to reduce serial waits.
- Default newly added Kimi providers to Chat Completions, refresh model capabilities and pricing, and keep default, summary and aggregate model groups pinned above alphabetically sorted providers.
- Improve subagent file-attribution evidence handling and time-window hints.

## Fixes

- Prevent Spec edits from silently dropping tables and other unsupported Markdown: default to source editing with split preview, add table support, and guard saves in rich-text mode. Preserve plain-text editing for non-Markdown files and behavior_fence.
- Preserve composer drafts and attachments when switching sessions during uploads; isolate stale callbacks and prevent duplicate uploads or unintended sends. Fix stuck file-drop overlays and drops leaking from message editors into the outer composer.
- Correct failed-run status settlement and answered-question delivery detection so restarts do not spuriously replay completed work; retain loop diagnostics and do not count empty assistant shells as delivered replies.
- Preserve already-produced tool calls when guidance arrives; end Await promptly without cancelling its target task.
- Restore terminal cursor-position and device-query replies for atuin, Codex CLI and similar programs while preventing duplicate replies and responses to replayed output.
- Remove blocking process-tree cleanup from the main thread, and avoid scanning full-text indexes on the database startup path after an unclean shutdown.
- Harden Windows manager control traffic, tray and service lifecycle handling. Updates hand off to the new manager, and slow database migrations no longer trigger a fixed startup-failure deadline.
- Correct cache-hit-rate accounting and version historical token recalculation to prevent repeated adjustments; fix the related Windows executable build failure.
- Fix stale worktree identifiers blocking working-directory switches and archived sessions reappearing in recent tabs.
- Fix case-sensitive repository matching during update-mirror imports, and improve bounded parallel binary distribution with partial receipts and redacted transfer diagnostics.
- Preserve arbitrary JSON tool parameters when converting any/unknown schemas.

## Security

- Update undici and KaTeX to address dependency security advisories and adapt formula measurement to the updated renderer.
- Upgrade and pin ProseMirror View to 1.42.3 to fix an XSS vulnerability when pasting untrusted HTML into rich-text editors.

## Upgrade Notes

- This version is published on the beta / prerelease channel and continues to use executor-v0.9.4 and helpers-v1.0.0.
- Database migrations are included; back up your database before upgrading. Historical usage recalculation is an explicit maintenance action, not an automatic full-history rewrite.
- Send no longer waits for replies through await/timeout/replyTo. Update custom agent instructions to use asynchronous Send replies and Await only when waiting for task completion.
notes.zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增 ToolSearch，按能力发现并加载可选工具组与 MCP 工具；MCP 支持禁用、自动与常驻三种加载模式。
- 新增 /modeltrace 单轮模型指纹测试，复用原会话前缀与缓存身份，以精简视图展示前五名候选概率，并可返回原会话。
- 用量历史新增按需打开的历史 token 重算弹窗，按协议分批处理；关闭弹窗后后台任务继续执行。
- 生成式 UI 预览支持 Bun 构建，补齐预览截图与运行时检查反馈。

## 改进

- Send 改为纯异步投递：接收方用普通消息回复，并在发送方空闲时唤醒。阻塞投递状态可见，提供恢复与丢弃操作，父代理可切换子代理模型。
- 代码语法分词移至 Worker，合并高亮更新通知并降低逐行渲染开销，改善长会话快速滚动体验。
- 改善页面与弹窗加载反馈，按界面分层加载翻译、预加载常用入口，减少串行等待。
- 新增 Kimi 供应商时默认使用 Chat Completions；更新模型能力与价格快照，模型菜单固定默认、摘要与聚合分组，其余按供应商名称排序。
- 改进子代理文件归属证据识别与时间窗提示。

## 修复

- 防止 Spec 编辑保存时静默丢失表格等 Markdown 内容：默认源码编辑并支持分栏预览，补齐表格支持，对富文本模式无法保真的内容限制保存；非 Markdown 文件与 behavior_fence 保持纯文本编辑。
- 修复上传附件时切换会话导致草稿或附件丢失，隔离过期回调，避免重复上传与意外发送；修复拖放浮层卡住、消息编辑器内拖放冒泡到外层输入框。
- 修正运行失败后的状态收尾与问题回答送达判断，避免重启后无故重放已结束工作；保留循环诊断，不再把空壳助手消息视为已回复。
- 即时引导不再丢弃已产生的工具调用；Await 收到引导时及时结束等待，但不取消目标任务。
- 恢复 atuin、Codex CLI 等程序所需的终端光标位置与设备查询响应，避免重复应答和历史输出回放误应答。
- 进程树清理不再同步阻塞主线程；非正常关机后的数据库启动路径不再扫描全文索引。
- 加固 Windows 管理器控制通信、托盘与服务生命周期；更新后交接给新版本管理器，数据库迁移较慢时不再因固定启动时限误报失败。
- 修正缓存命中率计算，历史 token 重算增加口径版本以防重复调整，并修复相关 Windows 可执行文件构建失败。
- 修复过时的 worktree 标识阻止切换工作目录，以及归档会话重新出现在最近标签中的问题。
- 修复更新镜像导入时仓库名大小写匹配，改进二进制有界并行分发、部分完成回执与脱敏传输诊断。
- 修复 any/unknown schema 转换损坏任意 JSON 工具参数的问题。

## 安全加固

- 更新 undici 与 KaTeX，修复依赖安全告警，并适配新版公式渲染测量。
- 升级并锁定 ProseMirror View 1.42.3，修复富文本编辑器粘贴不可信 HTML 时的 XSS 漏洞。

## 升级说明

- 本版本发布到 beta / prerelease 通道，继续依赖 executor-v0.9.4 与 helpers-v1.0.0。
- 本次包含数据库迁移，升级前请备份数据库；历史用量重算需显式触发，不会自动重写全部历史记录。
- Send 不再通过 await/timeout/replyTo 等待回复；自定义代理提示词应改用异步 Send 回复，仅在等待任务完成时使用 Await。
